Documents.DataSql: SELECT title AS plttl, description AS pldsc, details AS pldtl, review_state_id AS m_state, title AS m_raw_title, id AS m_target_id FROM place;

SELECT title AS lcttl, CASE WHEN start_year=0 AND end_year=0 THEN NULL ELSE start_year END AS m_year_min, CASE WHEN start_year=0 AND end_year=0 THEN NULL ELSE end_year END AS m_year_max, certainty_id AS m_certainty, review_state_id AS m_state, place_id AS m_target_id FROM location;

SELECT romanized AS nmrmz, attested AS nmatt, description AS nmdsc, CASE WHEN start_year=0 AND end_year=0 THEN NULL ELSE start_year END AS m_year_min, CASE WHEN start_year=0 AND end_year=0 THEN NULL ELSE end_year END AS m_year_max, review_state_id AS m_state, romanized AS m_raw_romanized, place_id AS m_target_id FROM name;
